title: All Mine
description: explore the plains and found the miencraft monument, get the key and find the vault and get op loots
body:
Welcome to the All minecraft! a mod that will try to force u explore the world!
# Minecraft Monument
appear on PLain and meadows, its a rere strocture with 4 diagonal pillars that represents the overworld, the ocean, the nether and the end, in the middles has gravel, a iron block, a diamond ore, a cobble stone, and a ancient debris! a obsidian box that inside has 2 chests, one have copper a undying totem and the 2 versions of the trial chambers keys, and the other have some iron and "THE KEY"
# The vault
appear on sould sand in teh nether, in the warm ocean, in the end and in the plains, its a structure that have a locked vault, open it with "THE KEY" and get some op loot!
